subject: a slate-grey shadow wolf with a shaggy dark mane, amber eyes and dark smoke wisps trailing from its mane, back and tail
persistentDetails: the dark smoke wisps trailing from the mane, back and tail
the warm orange rim light along the chest and legs
style: Pixel art, crisp square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, limited palette, 1-pixel dark outline, flat shadow tones, one warm orange rim light.

poses.name: walk
poses.motion: It walks at a calm, steady pace with a natural gait, one full stride after another, head level and tail relaxed.

poses.name: curl_up
poses.motion: It stops walking, slowly lies down and curls up into a sleeping ball with the tail wrapped around the body, closes its eyes and then stays still.

poses.name: tail_wag
poses.motion: Still curled up with eyes closed, it gently wags the tail a few times and then lays the tail back exactly where it started.
